g.text: Source: dynamics/results CSVs. 60 Hz, two mechanical substeps; timings exclude output and rendering.
Cost: frames 31-360. Grey time band: forcing applied to two orange cells. Both fields share scales.
Stokes and LBM have different transient physics; the cells remain permeable. No irregular fluid walls tested.
